steps.title: Write the offsite goal in one sentence
steps.rationale: Every other choice, from venue to agenda, follows from what the offsite must achieve

steps.title: List the attendees and confirm the dates with them
steps.rationale: Headcount and dates constrain the venue search, so they come before it

steps.title: Shortlist three venues that fit the headcount and budget
steps.rationale: A short list makes the booking decision quick once dates are confirmed

steps.title: Book the venue and send calendar invites
steps.rationale: Booking locks the plan so agenda work can start against a fixed place and time

steps.title: Draft the agenda and share it for comments
steps.rationale: The agenda is only useful once the logistics are settled
